name: Raw heap array versus std::vector and QVector sum loop
listed_description: Book times filling and summing 100 million ints in a plain new[] array, std::vector with push_back and at(), and Qt QVector with push_back and at(), using QElapsedTimer.
claim_text: Array took 650 ms, STL vector about 3,830 ms, Qt vector about 5,400 ms; the plain array is fastest.
book_benchmark: Single run of 100,000,000 ints on the author's computer; compiler, flags (likely a default Qt Creator build) and CPU not stated. Vector grows by push_back with no reserve and reads via bounds-checked at(), so the array win is partly idiom difference. Code in the Chapter14 folder of the companion repository.
found_in: book: Qt 6 C++ GUI Programming Cookbook (2024), ch. 14 Performance Optimization, section Optimizing forms and C++, How to do it step 7 and How it works

name: QThreadPool with QRunnable
listed_description: Qt thread pool that recycles worker threads to run QRunnable tasks, with max thread count, expiry timeout and auto-delete controls.
claim_text: QThreadPool recycles QThread objects to avoid creating and destroying threads too frequently, reducing computing costs.
book_benchmark: No timing. Book only prints active thread count (four, then zero after three seconds) for four tasks started on the global pool.
guessed_baseline: spawning one QThread or std::thread per task
found_in: book: Qt 6 C++ GUI Programming Cookbook (2024), ch. 8 Threading Basics, section Working with QRunnable processes, How it works

name: Qt Quick (QML engine and scene graph)
listed_description: Qt declarative UI module (QML and Qt Quick) rendering through the GPU, presented as faster than the CPU-rendered QWidget raster engine for animated graphics.
claim_text: QML engine uses hardware acceleration; rendering and performance superior to the old widgets user interface. QWidget uses a software raster engine.
book_benchmark: No comparison measured. Book shows frame-rate counter and QML Profiler for a penguin animation demo, no numbers against QWidget.
found_in: book: Qt 6 C++ GUI Programming Cookbook (2024), ch. 14 Performance Optimization, sections Profiling and optimizing QML and Rendering and animation
